decision: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
fact: The following Power Unit elements have been used: 3rd Energy Store (ES) 3rd Control Electronics (CE) All Power Unit elements were replaced without the approval of the FIA Technical Delegate during Parc Ferme.
offence: Breaches of Articles 28.2 and 40.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
reason: The Power Unit elements used are in excess of the permitted number for the 2024 Championship season. This is a breach of Article 28.2 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations. Further, the parts have been replaced without the approval of the Technical Delegate, this being a breach of Article 40.3. Therefore Car 20 is required to start the Race from pit lane in accordance with Article 40.9.
rules_referenced: Article 28.2 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
